      "step": 1,
      "text": "{{ing_01|MILK-FED PIG}}, KILLED ON THE PREVIOUS DAY, BOIL WITH {{ing_02|SALT}} AND {{ing_03|DILL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "TRANSFER IT INTO COLD WATER, CAREFULLY KEEPING IT SUBMERGED, TO PRESERVE ITS WHITENESS."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "THEREUPON [make a cold dressing of the following] {{ing_04|GREEN SAVORY HERBS}}, {{ing_05|[fresh] THYME}}, {{ing_06|A LITTLE FLEABANE}}, {{ing_07|HARD BOILED EGGS}}, {{ing_08|ONIONS}}, [everything] CHOPPED FINE."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "SPRINKLE EVERYTHING [over the pig which has been taken out of the water and allowed to drip off] AND SEASON WITH {{ing_09|A PINT OF BROTH}}, {{ing_10|ONE MEASURE OF OIL}}, {{ing_11|ONE OF RAISIN WINE}}, AND SO PRESENT IT."
